todos.research_question: For the HTTP status code 401 Unauthorized, what does it mean according to the HTTP specification, including how it relates to authentication and the meaning of the response in terms of client credentials?
todos.evidence_needed: RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics) section for 401 Unauthorized showing the definition and role of authentication/credentials (including WWW-Authenticate guidance).

todos.research_question: For the HTTP status code 403 Forbidden, what does it mean according to the HTTP specification, including how it relates to authorization/permissions and what the server is indicating to the client?
todos.evidence_needed: RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics) section for 403 Forbidden showing the definition and role of authorization/permissions (and what it implies about whether authentication succeeded).

todos.research_question: According to the HTTP specification, when should a server return 401 Unauthorized versus 403 Forbidden (e.g., cases involving missing/invalid authentication vs authenticated-but-lacking permission), and what wording or headers (like WWW-Authenticate) are implied?
todos.evidence_needed: RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics) sections comparing 401 vs 403 (and any explicit guidance) showing the decision rule and when each code is appropriate (including implications such as WWW-Authenticate for 401).
